body.objective: Certify (or obstruct) analytic continuation of the Schwarzschild exterior mode families and the Lee-Wald symplectic current from real frequency to an explicitly declared complex-frequency domain, both parities, before any BH-3 vocabulary is admissible.
body.stop_condition: Import the real-frequency evidence base by exact hashes: BH2_SYMBOLIC_CROSS_INVARIANT (axial a(omega) exact rational, poles {I, I/2}), BH2_GENERAL_L_STRUCTURAL, BH2C_METRIC_ALL_ORDERS, and BH2_POLAR_QUANTIFIER_REPAIR. Declare the complex-omega domain explicitly. For the AXIAL sector, prove the Frobenius mode series and the reduced cross scalar continue analytically on that domain, isolate every pole/branch point/convergence boundary, and prove the symplectic current continues. For the POLAR sector, first obtain the symbolic-omega identity named in BH2_POLAR_QUANTIFIER_REPAIR route B (Z = E - (K^{-1}a^H).X symplectically null for all real omega) or record the polar continuation as NOT_ACTIVATED. Either land a two-parity analytic-continuation theorem with an exact singular set, or certify the first analyticity obstruction (pole, branch point, or divergent-flux boundary) and its exact location. A finite set of complex sample frequencies cannot establish continuation.
body.current_gate: complex-omega analytic continuation of modes and current, or exact obstruction
body.forbid: no Conflux; no numerical sample called analytic continuation; no continuation through a pole of a(omega); no polar continuation extrapolated from real-omega fixtures; no stability, quasinormal, ringdown, scattering, positivity, particle, or quantum claim
activates: the analytic-continuation entry gate of the BH-3 proof-obligation DAG
body.resource_hint: Analytic-continuation gate for BH-3 readiness. The axial reduced invariant a(omega) is already an exact rational function (meromorphic); the work is the full mode/current continuation and the polar route-B prerequisite. Not a mode-sampling task.
